card.name: Words just before a named drug
card.fires_on: The word therapy, treated, or with right before a drug or drug class is named, as in "before initiating therapy with" or "during treatment with".

modes.label: Before starting therapy
modes.description: The word therapy or with after "before initiating" in hypersensitivity warnings, just ahead of the drug name.
modes.example: Before initiating<< therapy>> with ertapenem, careful

modes.label: Patients treated with
modes.description: The word treated after "in patients", followed by a drug class.
modes.example: with or without warning symptoms, in patients<< treated>> with NSAIDs.

modes.label: During treatment with
modes.description: The word with after "during treatment" in contraception advice, followed by a brand name.
modes.example: to use effective contraception during treatment<< with>> XTANDI and for 3 months

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug name is given, in phrases like "therapy with" or "treated with".
